title: Prescribed Fourier kernel formula
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\mathcal F$ be a nonempty finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $a,x\in\{−1,1\}^n$. The prescribed Fourier kernel at $a$ and $x$ is $1/|\mathcal F|$ times the sum, over $S\in\mathcal F$, of the monomial indexed by $S$ evaluated at $a$ multiplied by that monomial evaluated at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal F$ is a finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
$a$ and $x$ belong to the sign cube $\{−1,1\}^n$
